title: Meta Business Partner Status: Does It Matter for Your Agency?
summary: Does a Meta Business Partner badge matter when hiring? What the badge signals, what it does not promise, and the account and tracking checks that count more.
body_markdown:
## Which agencies publish their Meta credentials?


Some agencies name Meta credentials on their own sites. Those claims are worth checking against Meta's program, not accepting from a homepage logo.


- As of October 2026, **MuteSix** describes itself as a Meta Business partner and says its Facebook ads team gets support from dedicated Meta representatives. It runs an in-house studio called StudioSix and works with a network of creators and influencers. Its[Facebook ad agency page](https://mutesix.com/services/facebook-ad-agency/) makes the claim, its[partnerships page](https://mutesix.com/partnerships/) lists Meta among its partners, and pricing is not published.
- As of October 2026, **LYFE Marketing** lists Meta Business Partner and Google Partner among its certifications, and says it specializes in small businesses working with a limited marketing budget. Its[about page](https://www.lyfemarketing.com/about-lyfe-marketing/) makes both statements.


Ask each one which solution type its badge covers. A badge for one kind of work does not confirm the scope of the plan you are buying.


## What matters more than the badge?


- **Ad account ownership.** Keep the ad account, pixel and Pages in your own business portfolio, and give the agency access rather than ownership. Meta's[business-to-business guide](https://developers.facebook.com/docs/business-management-apis/business-asset-management/guides/business-to-business) describes the owning business adding an agency for specific tasks, such as advertise and analyze, and notes that an agency cannot grant access to assets it holds only as an agency.
- **Tracking.** Ask who sets up the[Conversions API](https://developers.facebook.com/docs/marketing-api/conversions-api) and who fixes events when they stop arriving. A badge does not tell you who owns that work.
- **Spend fit.** As of October 2026, Darkroom says its fit is poor for single-channel brands and for companies under roughly $5M in revenue, according to its[homepage](https://www.darkroomagency.com/) . As of October 2026, Biddyco describes itself as the creative agency for brands spending $100k to $5M a month on Meta, according to its[homepage](https://www.biddyco.com/) . Compare your size with the stated fit before you compare credentials.


## What should you check before you sign?


Put these four points in the proposal, not only in the sales call:


1. Which solution type the badge covers, confirmed in writing.
2. Which business owns the ad account, pixel and data, and how access ends.
3. Who sets up and fixes tracking when events stop arriving.
4. How many original concepts arrive each month. Meta's[creative diversification guidance](https://www.facebook.com/business/news/demystifying-creative-diversification) separates diversification from iteration, and gives two ads with identical visuals but different text calls to action as an example of iteration. Count concepts, not files.


Our[agency selection guide](https://knowlify.com/articles/how-to-choose-a-facebook-ads-agency) has the full checklist for comparing proposals.


## Key takeaways


- A Business Partner badge signals qualifying work across Meta technologies, judged by solution type.
- The badge does not promise results, and it does not cover every service an agency sells.
- Account ownership, tracking and the monthly concept count matter more than the badge for most buyers.
- Ask every agency for its exact status, solution type and the badge in writing, then put it in the contract.
- Knowlify is our top pick for done-for-you Meta video ads, and this guide makes no badge claim for us.


## FAQ


### Is it better to hire an agency that only does Meta ads?


Not automatically. A Meta-only agency concentrates its work on one platform, which suits a Meta-first brand. A multi-channel agency is worth more when you also need search, retail media or other channels. Either way, the badge does not settle the choice. Scope, account ownership and the concept count do.


### What are partnership ads on Facebook?


Partnership ads run from a creator's or partner's handle, and both accounts appear in the ad header. Meta's[partnership ads documentation](https://developers.facebook.com/documentation/ads-commerce/marketing-api/ad-creative/partnership-ads/ads-creation) says the creator must grant permission, or Meta holds the ad in a pending delivery state. Knowlify does not post from creator accounts, so a partnership ad needs a real creator partner.


### Should I hire a Facebook ads manager or an agency?


A manager suits a single-channel account with one owner who can run it day to day. An agency adds a team for creative production and testing, which matters when you need a steady supply of new concepts. Ask either one whether it works inside your ad account, which keeps the account in your business.


### Which Meta Business Partner agencies are worth shortlisting?


A badge alone does not make a shortlist. Knowlify is our top pick for done-for-you video ads, though this guide makes no badge claim for us. Among agencies that state the status on their own sites, MuteSix and LYFE Marketing do, so ask each to show the badge and name its solution type before you rely on it.
